content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Deviation — § 19 Non-Solicitation of Employees (p0133).** The clause is a mutual *no-hire* ("not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire"), covering *any* employee of the other party, running for one year after termination, with no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. No-hire provisions and all-personnel scope are walk-away items in the playbook.

Because the restriction is already mutual, I took the fallback rather than deleting it outright: a 12-month mutual non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the services, measured from the end of that individual's involvement, with carve-outs for general advertisements/recruitment campaigns and unsolicited approaches. Redline validated (ok:true).
